(5U) CHARGERS -3-110 The Las Vegas Raiders are 1-11 (8.3%) in their last 12 games as an underdog. The Los Angeles Chargers are 8-2 (80.0%) against the spread in their last 10 games as a favorite. The Raiders edged New England behind Geno Smith, but it was far less convincing. With Harbaugh's impact already showing, the Chargers look primed to cover in Vegas.
